# nologin.tools

> A curated directory of privacy-friendly online tools that work immediately without login, registration, or account creation.

nologin.tools indexes web-based applications, utilities, and software that respect user privacy, run without signups or passwords, and get tasks done in seconds. The directory is maintained by [NoLoginTools.org](https://nologintools.org), an independent non-profit initiative advocating for the No-Login Web.

## Core Principles

- **No Account Required**: Zero sign-up, zero login, no email, phone number, or password required to perform core functionality.
- **Privacy-First**: Preference for client-side processing (WebAssembly, Web Crypto, Canvas) where data never leaves the user's device.
- **Zero Friction**: Direct in-browser task execution without paywalls, email collection gates, or forced onboarding.
- **Health Monitored**: Automated uptime checks run every 6 hours; offline tools provide web.archive.org fallbacks.
- **Verified Badge**: Tools undergo manual review and receive a cryptographic/SVG trust signal ("NoLogin Verified").

## Tool Categories & Architectural Hubs

Each category hub includes architectural deep-dives, client-side technology trade-off matrices, and curated zero-signup toolchains:

- [AI Tools](https://nologin.tools/category/ai): Client-side WebLLM/ONNX vs stateless proxy APIs without login barriers.
- [Design & Graphics](https://nologin.tools/category/design): In-browser raster, vector, and SVG generation via Canvas and WebAssembly.
- [Writing & Text](https://nologin.tools/category/writing): Local-first markdown editors, spell checkers, and distraction-free document workspaces.
- [Development](https://nologin.tools/category/development): Code formatters, regex debuggers, AST parsers, and WebAssembly compilation sandboxes.
- [Productivity](https://nologin.tools/category/productivity): WebAssembly PDF manipulation, timers, and standalone browser utilities.
- [Media & Audio](https://nologin.tools/category/media): Web Audio API DAWs, client-side video trimmers, and FFmpeg.wasm transcoders.
- [Privacy & Security](https://nologin.tools/category/privacy): Web Crypto API AES-GCM encryption, ephemeral file sharing, and browser fingerprint auditors.
- [Data & Analytics](https://nologin.tools/category/data): DuckDB-WASM and client-side CSV/JSON/SQL transformation engines.
- [Communication](https://nologin.tools/category/communication): Peer-to-peer WebRTC transfers, disposable inboxes, and accountless meeting pollers.
- [Education](https://nologin.tools/category/education): Interactive STEM simulations, graphing calculators, and algorithmic visualizers.
- [Finance](https://nologin.tools/category/finance): Monte Carlo retirement models, currency converters, and local-first amortization tools.

## Featured Verified Tools (50 Core Tools)

### Design & Graphics
- [Photopea](https://nologin.tools/tool/photopea-com): Photoshop alternative running entirely in-browser supporting PSD, XCF, Sketch.
- [Excalidraw](https://nologin.tools/tool/excalidraw-com): Hand-drawn virtual whiteboard with end-to-end encrypted real-time collaboration.
- [tldraw](https://nologin.tools/tool/tldraw-com): Infinite canvas for vector sketching, wireframes, and diagrams.
- [Squoosh](https://nologin.tools/tool/squoosh-app): Google-engineered image compression engine running MozJPEG/WebP entirely via WebAssembly.
- [TinyPNG](https://nologin.tools/tool/tinypng-com): Smart lossy WebP, PNG, and JPEG image compression.
- [SVGOMG](https://nologin.tools/tool/jakearchibald-github-io-svgomg): Client-side SVGO visual GUI for stripping bloat from SVG files.
- [Fffuel](https://nologin.tools/tool/fffuel-co): 40+ generative SVG tools for gradient meshes, waves, and organic textures.
- [SVG-Edit](https://nologin.tools/tool/svgedit-netlify-app-editor-index-html): In-browser open-source vector graphics editor.
- [Coolors](https://nologin.tools/tool/coolors-co): Superfast color palette generator with hex export.
- [Favicon.io](https://nologin.tools/tool/favicon-io): Instant favicon generator from text, image, or emoji.
- [Remove.bg](https://nologin.tools/tool/remove-bg): AI-powered background remover for portraits and product photos.

## Curated No-Login Workflow Recipes

End-to-end procedural recipes chaining 2 to 4 verified no-login web tools to accomplish complete tasks without creating accounts or paying subscription fees:

- [Private Podcast Production Pipeline](https://nologin.tools/workflow/private-podcast-production): AudioMass DAW recording → Audio Trimmer clip boundary editing → Squoosh cover art compression → Wormhole E2EE ephemeral sharing.
- [Confidential PDF Redaction & Sharing](https://nologin.tools/workflow/secure-document-redaction): PDF24 document sanitization → CyberChef metadata stripping → hat.sh client-side AES-256 encryption → Wormhole self-destruct delivery.
- [Vector Graphic to Production Web Asset](https://nologin.tools/workflow/vector-to-web-asset): Excalidraw conceptual sketch → SVG-Edit node refinement → SVGOMG SVGO XML minification → Squoosh responsive WebP/AVIF generation.
- [Distraction-Free Anonymous Publishing](https://nologin.tools/workflow/anonymous-markdown-publishing): Dillinger split markdown writing → Hemingway Editor readability polish → LanguageTool grammar check → Write.as anonymous web publishing.
- [Developer API Payload & Token Debugging](https://nologin.tools/workflow/api-payload-debugging): JSON Crack tree visualization → JSON Formatter RFC 8259 validation → transform.tools code type generation → JWT.io bearer token decoding.
- [Ephemeral Zero-Account Team Meeting](https://nologin.tools/workflow/ephemeral-team-sync): When2meet participant time polling → Jitsi Meet encrypted video room → Excalidraw real-time collaborative E2EE whiteboard.
- [Tabular Data Cleansing & Charting](https://nologin.tools/workflow/csv-data-cleansing-and-viz): CSVJSON delimited data normalization → TableConvert Markdown/LaTeX format bridging → RAWGraphs publication-ready D3 vector charts.
- [Social Media Graphic & GIF Optimization](https://nologin.tools/workflow/social-media-media-prep): Photopea multi-layer raster composition → ezGIF frame trimming & lossy GIF optimizer → Squoosh WebP responsive image compression.
- [Spatial Data Mapping & Format Pipeline](https://nologin.tools/workflow/geodata-to-interactive-map): GeoJSON.io geometry marker & polygon drawing → Convertio coordinate format conversion → RAWGraphs density and spatial distribution visualization.
- [Complete Browser Leak & Security Audit](https://nologin.tools/workflow/browser-privacy-and-leak-audit): IPLeak WebRTC & IP leak audit → DNS Leak Test resolver integrity verification → Security Headers HTTP security evaluation → privacy.sexy OS telemetry removal scripts.

## Verification Model & Ranking Formula


Every tool submitted to nologin.tools is audited under a strict verification lifecycle:
1. **Zero-Login Gate Check**: If any core function requires registration or payment, the tool is rejected.
2. **Network & Tracker Audit**: DevTools traffic inspection to verify data processing claims (client-side vs remote).
3. **Automated Health Monitoring**: Automated health workers verify HTTP reachability every 6 hours.
4. **Wayback Machine Integration**: If an approved tool becomes unreachable, directory links automatically fallback to web.archive.org.

Recommendation ranking score formula:
```
score = badge_weight + freshness + health + featured
```
Where badge_weight rewards tool authors displaying the official NoLogin trust badge (+10 pts SVG / +5 pts meta link), freshness rewards recently verified tools (+5 pts <30d, +3 pts <90d), health rewards active uptime (+3 pts), and featured highlights curated editorial spotlights (+8 pts).

## Trust, Certification & Authority

- [No-Login Tool Finder](https://nologin.tools/finder): Interactive multi-criteria decision wizard filtering by task, offline capability, client-side encryption, and open source.
- [Developer Open Platform](https://nologin.tools/developers): API documentation, SDK snippets, OpenAPI specs, and MCP server for AI agents.
- [What is NoLogin Verified?](https://nologin.tools/badge): Explanation of the trust standard for users and developers.
- [Get Verification Badge](https://nologin.tools/submit): Developer submission form for getting a tool verified and receiving the embeddable trust badge.
- [About NoLoginTools](https://nologin.tools/about): Mission, ethics, and dual-brand structure.
- [Organization Authority](https://nologintools.org): Independent non-profit foundation providing governance, research reports, and standards.
- [The State of No-Login Web 2026 Report](https://nologintools.org/reports/state-of-no-login-web-2026): Annual industry whitepaper on the shift toward zero-friction, private web software.

## Developer API & AI Machine Protocols

nologin.tools provides open, zero-friction programmatic APIs and protocol definitions for software engineers and AI agents:

- [Developer Portal](https://nologin.tools/developers): Interactive API guide, endpoint documentation, badge integration, and MCP instructions.
- [Public Tools API](https://nologin.tools/api/v1/tools): REST endpoint for querying, filtering, and searching verified tools (`?q=`, `?category=`, `?clientSide=`, `?offline=`, `?openSource=`, `?free=`).
- [Workflows API](https://nologin.tools/api/v1/workflows): Programmatic retrieval of zero-signup multi-tool workflows and integration pipelines.
- [OpenAPI 3.1.0 Specification](https://nologin.tools/api/v1/openapi.json): Complete machine-readable OpenAPI contract.
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server](https://nologin.tools/api/v1/mcp.json): Tool declarations (`search_nologin_tools`, `get_tool_details`, `list_workflows`) for LLM agents (Claude Desktop, Cursor, LangChain).
- [Dynamic SVG Badge API](https://nologin.tools/api/badge/{slug}.svg): Real-time verification status badge for READMEs and websites.
